name: dpc-aio-companion
description: Build, diagnose, enroll, verify, and package DPC-AIO 1.2.0 Enterprise + Samsung OEM AIO using bounded repository-native workflows.

interface.longDescription: A skills-only companion for DPC-AIO 1.2.0. It guides production release builds, root-cause-first CI diagnosis, Android Enterprise QR verification, protected-operation and Package Trust checks, Samsung/Knox/SEM/OEM capability evidence, QR release-bundle validation, and bounded pre-push verification without owning device-management execution.
capabilities: Build DPC-AIO Gradle variants using the repository wrapper
Diagnose GitHub Actions build failures from concrete logs
Verify production work-profile and fully-managed provisioning QR artifacts
Verify Protected Targets and Enterprise Transaction contracts
Verify deterministic Android/Knox/SEM/OEM capability routing without bypasses
Verify Package Trust 2.0 and hardened APK+ importer contracts
Verify Work Profile Lifecycle 2.0 and Credential Recovery 2.0 contracts
Run repository-native pre-push, secret and non-SDK safety checks
Resolve exact Gradle/JDK/Android SDK build readiness without silent substitution
Run SAFE device preflight and functional verification harnesses
defaultPrompt: Build the EnterpriseRelease DPC-AIO variant and report the first blocker.
Diagnose this DPC-AIO GitHub Actions failure from the log.
Verify DPC-AIO 1.2.0 including QR release bundle, protected operations, Package Trust and Samsung capability gates.
